scope: Exact committed bytes of scratch-branch diagnostic probe sources, selected artifact files and bounded extracts from the 60 runs listed in run-metadata.json, and GitHub API metadata. Text copies are LF-normalized for the repository's eol=lf rule by replacing CRLF with LF repeatedly until none remains; PPM frames are converted to PNG. Original artifact file sizes and hashes are in run-metadata.json (rounds 1-11 and the product builds) and in the sources.json of rounds 12-28, 36-50 and 51-54; rounds 29-35 record only their artifact ZIP digests, in run-metadata.json.
